summary: RTL - shopping sidebar container flickers on the right side when opening/closing the sidebar
description:
STR:
1. Enable bidi mode in Browser Toolbox (alternatively: load Firefox in RTL language)
2. Make sure sidebar feature is enabled and profile is opted in
2. View product page ([example](https://www.amazon.com/SteelSeries-Arctis-Multi-System-Gaming-Headset/dp/B0B8Q4CR52/)) and ensure shopping sidebar is visible
3. Close sidebar with urlbar shopping icon or the close button on the sidebar

Expected:
- there should be no sudden flicker on the right side of the page when closing/opening the sidebar in RTL mode

Actual:
- there is a slight flicker on the right side of the page, which is very distracting visually

Notes:
- this issue probably existed for a while, but I believe that it will be way more obvious once [we show sidebar animations](bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1858762).
- I tested this on MacOS and can't recall at the moment if it also occurs on other platforms
